method: Enumerated the frozen baseline Git tree and resolved every backtick-enclosed production-source reference in findings.md; numeric line anchors were checked against the indexed source's physical line count.
Computed the Git blob SHA-1 as SHA-1 of 'blob <byte length>\0' followed by the exact source bytes, and required it to match the baseline tree object; SHA-256 is over the same bytes.
Read tracked text from the task worktree where available. Each binary GLB was independently hashed from the alternate local checkout and required to match the exact pinned baseline tree object.

The Metal RT patch is omitted from the sparse checkout: its baseline Git object was hashed directly in memory and is labeled baseline_git_blob_only. The shadow plan was verified in the worktree before any authorized audit-navigation edit.

Listed prior shadow plans, implementation/evidence records, existing tests and current Metal RT plan/experiment evidence as supporting sources. Inclusion is provenance, not a claim that each cited test or experiment ran in this audit.
limits: Hash equality establishes source identity, not rendered shadow correctness, GPU performance, package qualification or physical validation.
Binary GLBs have no meaningful text line count, so their line_count is null; they retain size, exact bytes' SHA-256, pinned Git blob and permalink.
New audit report, fixture, validation and evidence files are not part of the baseline commit and are not represented as matching baseline source blobs.
The sparse-only patch has no working-tree file match; source identity is established by the baseline Git object only.

sources.resolution_note: The report's atmosphere.gd basename is resolved to render/atmosphere.gd; physics/atmosphere.gd is a different tracked file.

pre_navigation_edit_verification.method: worktree file matched the pinned baseline before the orchestrator's planned navigation edit

sources.availability_note: The source is not checked out in the available sparse trees. Its baseline Git object was read and hashed in memory; no checked-out-file match is asserted.
